knowledgeAnswers.rationale: VBA consumer page on pool safety barriers: a barrier must be capable of containing water deeper than 300 mm.

VBA Building Practice Note SP 01 says site fencing considered under regulation 116 must include provisions to restrict access during excavation, during construction and once the pool can contain water.

VBA Building Practice Note SP 01 says building work for a pool and barrier must commence within 12 months of the building permit's issue date and be completed within six months of commencement (regulations 53 and 54).

practicalCriteria: For a supplied site, checks the building requirements, including site fencing, with the building surveyor, and records the check before starting.
Tracks a supplied water level against the 300 mm barrier depth in the VBA consumer page, and stops filling and reports when the barrier position is not agreed with the building surveyor.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of the stop-fill response
stopWorkCriteria: Water above 300 mm and the barrier position not agreed with the building surveyor: stop filling and report.
Building requirements, including site fencing, not agreed with the building surveyor before starting: stop and report.
Concrete pool fill requested before the building requirements are checked: hold the fill and escalate.
